item.title: ‘Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story’ Shares the Tears, Fears, Insights of a Unique Clown
item.description: Stand-up comedy is best live — and often lived. Judd Apatow and comedy appreciator Neil Berkeley know this.
